\tikzset{
  fdl/.style={line width=0.8pt, black},
  fdx/.style={circle, fill=black, inner sep=0pt, minimum size=3.6pt},
  fdv/.style={circle, fill=figB, draw=figB, inner sep=0pt, minimum size=5pt},
  fdlab/.style={font=\scriptsize, inner sep=2.6pt},
  fdmom/.style={->, >=Stealth, figO, line width=0.6pt},
}
\tikzset{
  fda/.style={fdl, postaction={decorate}, decoration={markings, mark=at position 0.55 with {\arrow{Stealth[length=5pt]}}}},
  fdS/.style={font=\small},
}
\tikzset{
  fline/.style={line width=0.8pt, black, postaction={decorate}, decoration={markings, mark=at position 0.56 with {\arrow{Stealth[length=5.5pt, width=4.5pt]}}}},
  sline/.style={line width=0.8pt, black, dash pattern=on 3.5pt off 2.2pt},
  blob/.style={draw, line width=0.8pt, fill=figB!12},
}
\tikzset{
  pline/.style={line width=0.8pt, black, decorate, decoration={snake, amplitude=1.6pt, segment length=5.2pt}},
}
\begin{tikzpicture}[font=\small, >=Stealth,
  mom/.style={->, line width=0.6pt, black},
  spinA/.style={-{Latex[length=2.4mm]}, line width=1.7pt, figB},
  spinB/.style={-{Latex[length=2.4mm]}, line width=1.7pt, figR}]
  \foreach \row/\y/\le/\lp/\se/\sp/\jz/\ok in {
     1/0/{e^-_R}/{e^+_L}/1/1/{+1}/{couples},
     2/-1.55/{e^-_L}/{e^+_R}/-1/-1/{-1}/{couples},
     3/-3.1/{e^-_R}/{e^+_R}/1/-1/{0}/{does not couple},
     4/-4.65/{e^-_L}/{e^+_L}/-1/1/{0}/{does not couple}} {
    \pgfmathsetmacro{\c}{\row<3 ? 1 : 0}
    \draw[mom] (-3.0,\y)--(-0.9,\y); \draw[mom] (3.0,\y)--(0.9,\y);
    \ifnum\row<3 \def\st{spinA}\else\def\st{spinB}\fi
    \ifnum\se=1 \draw[\st] (-2.35,\y+0.32)--(-1.55,\y+0.32); \else \draw[\st] (-1.55,\y+0.32)--(-2.35,\y+0.32); \fi
    \ifnum\sp=1 \draw[\st] (1.55,\y+0.32)--(2.35,\y+0.32); \else \draw[\st] (2.35,\y+0.32)--(1.55,\y+0.32); \fi
    \node[below] at (-1.95,\y-0.03) {$\le$}; \node[below] at (1.95,\y-0.03) {$\lp$};
    \node[anchor=west, align=left, font=\footnotesize] at (3.6,\y+0.1) {$J_z = \jz$: \ok};
  }
  \draw[->, gray] (-3.0,0.95)--(-2.3,0.95); \node[font=\scriptsize, gray, right] at (-2.3,0.95) {$\hat{\mathbf z}$};
  \node[font=\scriptsize, align=left, anchor=west] at (-3.1,-5.6) {thin arrows: momenta; thick arrows: physical spins (blue: pair couples to the photon, red: does not)};
\end{tikzpicture}
